# Retail CoD 1.1d dedicated server: the trigger_lookat's fires and isLookingAt's
# answer through an S&D plant and defuse.
# map mp_carentan, g_gametype probe_lookat (whose main() calls
# maps\mp\gametypes\sd::main()), one client joined allies (the attacker) and one
# joined axis (the defender), dedicated 1, sv_maxclients 8, sv_pure 0, stock
# scr_* defaults. Captured 2026-09-11.
# The evidence is the server's own games_mp.log, not a client capture: the
# gametype is crates/gsc/tests/fixtures/semantics/client-probes/probe_lookat.gsc,
# which threads a waittill("trigger", other) and a once-a-frame isLookingAt poll
# onto every trigger_lookat the map spawned. The two client halves of the same
# run are crates/server/tests/fixtures/playerstate/mp_carentan-sd-plant-attacker.txt
# and -sd-defuse-defender.txt.
#
# Three shells, the gsc probe first, then the defender, then the attacker:
#   COD_LNXDED_HOME=<absolute, no '+'> SECS=420 \
#       tools/run_probe.sh client-probes/probe_lookat mp_carentan \
#           +set probe_teleport 1
#   cargo run -p vcod -- --net-probe 127.0.0.1:28970 --probe-defuse --probe-secs 400
#   cargo run -p vcod -- --net-probe 127.0.0.1:28970 --probe-plant --probe-secs 380
#
# probe_teleport 1 is what makes the run arrive at all. mp_carentan's allied S&D
# spawns sit some 3500 units through the town from bombzone_A at (-146, 2490),
# and a first retail run spent its whole 380 s walk never reaching the zone. The
# cvar turns on two teleports in the gsc probe:
#   - once per level, every playing client is put on an mp_teamdeathmatch_spawn
#     in the zone's courtyard, 416 units out for the attacker and 541 for the
#     defender;
#   - once level.bombmodel exists, every alive defender is put 20 units out from
#     the charge along the planter's own approach line (inside the client's
#     28-unit stop and inside check_bomb's 32), because the flak88 and the cart
#     ring the zone and a steered walk spent a whole 60 s fuse circling them;
#     and the planter is unlinked and put back on the attackers' spawn, because
#     standing 88 units out along the defender-to-bomb line its body was what
#     the lookat's second trace hit and no station fired until it left.
# The A/B gate in crates/server/tests never sets the cvar: it stands its clients
# where it wants them itself, so both teleport threads return at their first line.
#
# Record formats, one logPrint each, with the m:ss stamp stripped:
#   PROBE watch <entity> trigger_lookat
#       the census: every trigger_lookat that survived the gametype's
#       _gameobjects pass, in the order getEntArray returned them.
#   PROBE lookats <n>
#       how many that was.
#   PROBE teleport <num> <team> (origin)
#       the once-per-level courtyard spawn teleport, per client.
#   PROBE teleport_defender <num> (origin)
#       the post-plant landing 20 units from the charge.
#   PROBE teleport_planter <num> (origin)
#       the planter's unlink() plus setOrigin back to the attackers' spawn.
#   PROBE fire <entity> <getTime> <toucher> (origin)
#       one "trigger" notify: the trigger entity, the server's level clock in
#       ms, the toucher's entity number and where it stood. getTime() is the
#       same clock the client fixtures' serverTime carries, so a fire pairs with
#       a !trace line directly.
#   PROBE looking <entity> <getTime> <player>
#       one frame on which that player's isLookingAt answered true for that
#       trigger, polled at wait 0.05.
# The engine's own records are kept too: InitGame: lines are the level
# boundaries (the match-start restart, the round restarts), J;/Q; the joins and
# drops, W;/L; the round result and A; the two objective records, A;1;allies
# for the plant and A;0;axis for the defuse.
InitGame: \g_gametype\probe_lookat\gamename\main\mapname\mp_carentan\protocol\1\shortversion\1.1\sv_allowAnonymous\0\sv_floodProtect\1\sv_hostname\CoDHost\sv_maxclients\8\sv_maxPing\0\sv_maxRate\0\sv_minPing\0\sv_privateClients\0\sv_pure\0
PROBE watch 170 trigger_lookat
PROBE lookats 1
J;0;vcod
PROBE teleport 0 axis (216.00, 2088.00, -8.00)
J;1;vcod
PROBE teleport 1 allies (-512.00, 2688.00, -16.00)
